# Gist.ly

> > Gist.ly is an AI-powered platform that generates summaries of YouTube videos using ChatGPT technology.

The platform provides free video summarization services across diverse content including military analysis, language education, and religious topics. Users can quickly extract key information from YouTube videos without watching the entire content.

## Key Topics

- YouTube video summarization
- ChatGPT AI technology
- Ukrainian military technology (Flamingo FP5, Neptune)
- Defense industry analysis
- Border security updates
- FirePoint defense systems
- Ukrainian Armed Forces (ЗСУ)
- Military operational updates
- Language education (Turkish grammar)
- Religious content (Pentecost)
- Cruise missile technology
- Northern regions defense (Sumy, Kharkiv, Chernihiv)
- Volunteer support initiatives
- Associated Press reporting

## Core Platform

- [AI YouTube Video Summarizer - Free Summary With ChatGPT](https://gist.ly/youtube-summarizer): Main YouTube summarizer tool page using ChatGPT AI for video summaries

## Military Technology & Defense

- [Українська крилата ракета Фламінго: все, що відомо](https://gist.ly/youtube-summarizer/ukrayinska-krilata-raketa-flamingo-vse-sho-vidomo): Ukrainian Flamingo FP5 cruise missile overview with FirePoint specs

## Military Operations & Security Updates

- [Оперативний стан на кордонах України: Сумщина, Харків, Чернігів](https://gist.ly/youtube-summarizer/operativnij-stan-na-kordonah-ukrayini-sumshina-harkiv-chernigiv): Border security update from Ukrainian Border Guard Service
- [Оперативна ситуація на фронті: Запорізький напрямок](https://gist.ly/youtube-summarizer/operativna-situaciya-na-fronti-zaporizkij-napryamok): Zaporizhzhia frontline combat update: Huliaipole battles and operations

## Optional

- [Türkçede Sözcükte Yapı: Kök, Ek ve Türleri Anlama](https://gist.ly/youtube-summarizer/turkcede-sozcukte-yapi-kok-ek-ve-turleri-anlama): Turkish language structure guide: roots, affixes, and word formation
- [П'ятидесятниця: Дух Святий і Пробудження Церкви](https://gist.ly/youtube-summarizer/pyatidesyatnicya-duh-svyatij-i-probudzhennya-cerkvi): Pentecost history: Holy Spirit descent and church spiritual awakening
